text: The `pickle` module allows you to serialize Python objects. `pickle.dump(obj, file)` writes to a file, `pickle.load(file)` reads from it.
Remember that pickle files are binary. You must open the file in write-binary mode (`wb`) to save, and read-binary mode (`rb`) to load.
Unlike pickle, `json` can only serialize basic data types (dicts, lists, strings, numbers). To JSON-serialize a custom class, you must convert it to a dictionary first, often using `obj.__dict__`.
